raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner adopted a faulty methodology by using the “first listed date on IMDb Release Dates” instead of the earliest release date, leading to selection of a 2011 home-media date for the 1951 film “Week-End with Father” and shifting “Premium” to 2007 despite earlier evidence of 2006. This misinterpretation contradicted credible sources (Wikipedia, IMDb, TCM) indicating “Week-End with Father” (1951) predates “Premium” (2006), resulting in the wrong conclusion that “Premium” was earlier.
